job: Show a pricing plan as a row in billing or a card in a pricing grid.
purpose: In billing, a plan is one quiet row with its price and allowance. In a pricing grid it is a card with a name, a figure, a pitch, a feature list and one call to action. data-current marks the plan the reader is on; data-recommended marks the one to nudge toward.
useWhen: A pricing page compares tiers side by side.
A billing page shows the current plan with its price and allowance.
An upgrade dialog offers the next tier.

avoidWhen.when: A generic object that is not a price.
Only the list of included features is needed.
A usage figure against the plan limit.
A single setting that turns billing on or off.

states.name: current
states.how: data-current; the plan the reader is on

states.name: recommended
states.how: data-recommended; the plan to nudge toward

variants.useWhen: A plan shown as one quiet row in billing.
The highlighted card in a grid.
A plan card that should recede.
A plan set into the page.
The reader is on this plan.

parts.role: One sentence on who it is for.
What the plan includes in numbers.
